data.title: 美杜莎 Rider · 天马的梦
data.description: 开满野花的草原黄昏，她站在风里望向天空，身旁隐约有天马的虚影；不是战斗的召唤，而是被诅咒之前的、作为「美杜莎」之外某个自己的梦。
data.action: 开满野花的草原黄昏，她站在风里望向天空，身旁隐约有天马的虚影
data.promptProse: Medusa rests one hand against her opaque white long-sleeved maxi dress and watches the dusk sky over a wildflower meadow, purple hair moving slowly in the wind. A distant cloud suggests the pale winged horse of a dream rather than a physical battle companion. The medium view places flowers below her peaceful profile. Golden dusk light brightens her violet eyes and dress edge, with soft flower shadows receding through the grass.
